title: Course Schedule
description: There are a total of `numCourses` courses you have to take, labeled from 0 to `numCourses - 1`. You are given an array `prerequisites` where `prerequisites[i] = [a, b]` indicates you must take course `b` first if you want to take course `a`. Return `true` if you can finish all courses, or `false` otherwise.

hints.content: This problem is equivalent to detecting a cycle in a directed graph.
Kahn’s algorithm using indegree array or 3-color DFS cycle detection.
Maintain in-degree for each course. Enqueue courses with in-degree 0. If processed count === numCourses, return true.

solution.explanation:
Kahns Topological Sort algorithm. A graph has no cycles iff all nodes can be processed with in-degree 0.
Time Complexity: O(V + E)
Space Complexity: O(V + E)
